outcome: Decisional conflict regarding choice of delivery
cohort: The study included 90 nulliparous women aged 28-30 weeks of gestational age referred to health-care centers.
finding: Individual counseling during pregnancy significantly improved attitudes toward natural childbirth, reduced decisional conflict, and increased the selection of natural childbirth among nulliparous women.
mod_finding: The intervention group showed a significant increase in preferred natural childbirth compared to the control group.
gest_age: 28-30 weeks at enrollment, 34-36 weeks at comparison
